display_name: DURA 源域多抽头盲信道拟合方向诊断
description: 只读合法源 IQ，比较 DURA 原物理方向与 8、32、64 抽头正则拟合后的方向；源 clean 理想步长只作不可部署诊断。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 GPU0 FP32 TF32 off, two CPU threads, batch 8

data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 frozen source pilot physical IDs, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views; read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Oracle source IQ geometric diagnostic; no training, no deployable per-record oracle, no claim about target accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original DURA v1.0 source-only stage2 E20/4940
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura runtime checks original7/63/30, F_access false, TX_labels_read 0, target_training false
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: matched Phase1 source contract; no F weights or outputs
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed original DURA, independent of evaluated target scores

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0: at least 8192 MiB free, fewer than 3 total GPU apps and no other this-task GPU worker; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite output or any target/F/TX read; preserve stopped group and other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json with source per-view oracle geometry, residual ratio, kernel change; no checkpoint

metric_names: source ideal positive and signed one-step NMSE
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; source paired IQ geometry only

rows.method: Per-record ridge-fitted 8/32/64 complex FIR taps under DURA widely-linear action; compare source-only ideal positive/signed correction direction
rows.purpose: Determine whether source error has useful projected direction; no deployment or selection
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.budget_ref: 672 fixed source IQ pairs in 14 cells, batch 8; two-record real-checkpoint smoke

notes: Source clean is used only for an ideal line-step diagnostic, never as a deployable input; no TX, F weights or outputs, V or target data.
Current received and candidate IQ fit a per-record regularized FIR adjustment; no network is trained or checkpoint saved.
Fixed 672 source pilot records previously explored; DURA may have seen them; no claim about target identity performance or a general theoretical upper bound.
Four synthetic tests, a real DURA operator synthetic numerical check, one independent P0/P1 review; real source smoke occurs first.
